children: SSE posts a solid half-year update that shows the power-distribution company is on track, RBC Capital Markets analysts Alexander Wheeler and Ziyad Jasimuddin write. Full-year guidance is kept unchanged but remains subject to weather, market conditions and plant availability, with the key winter months yet to come, they write. Shares fall 0.8% to 2,470.00 pence. (adam.whittaker@wsj.com)
